I haven't opened a 2.2.2 issue yet, because there's nothing new on `main` to release. Both #41 and the commitlint commit you asked about (aef3262) are already in v2.2.1.

I also got something wrong in my v2.2.1 summary: I said the commitlint patch was still waiting for a maintainer. That came from #41's PR description; I hadn't checked its commits. In fact you added aef3262 as the last commit of #41. When #41 was squash-merged as 440b5eb, the `commitlint` job went into `ci.yml`, and that commit is the parent of the release commit c5ae856. It only changes CI, so the release notes don't mention it.

`git log v2.2.1..origin/main` is empty, so a 2.2.2 issue would have nothing in it right now. I posted this correction on #39: https://github.com/cv/pi-action/issues/39#issuecomment-6812338400

My question about what 2.2.2 should contain is still open on the issue. Tick "Open a 2.2.2 issue anyway, to release whatever lands on main next" if you still want one, "don't open" if not, or reply with what it should include.
